title: Enterprise contract exception optimizer and security questionnaire QA flow
creator: Sofia Patel
description: Problem: Sales and legal teams manually triage a high volume of MSA/DPA redline exceptions and SSQ (Security Questionnaire) answers. This creates inconsistent concessions, slow deal cycles, and hidden pricing leakage. Goal: Build an automated exception optimizer and QA flow that scores contract deviations (indemnity, liability caps, escrow, data residency), suggests graded concessions, and wires recommendations into the Sales contract UI and Legal intake queue. The optimizer should be experiment-ready so PM can run pricing/packaging tests (A/B for concession aggressiveness), and we can tie conversion and revenue delta back to specific clause relaxations. Scope: 1) Clause-level scoring model (probabilistic risk + revenue impact heuristics) 2) Integration with SSQ scoring to route exceptions (auto-approve / fast-path / legal-review) 3) Sales UI affordances: concession slider with pre-approved ranges per SLA tier 4) Telemetry and simulation harness to run counterfactuals on historical contract outcomes 5) Legal workflow automation: triage thresholds, SLAs, audit trail, and rollback. Out of scope for initial launch: full natural-language clause rewriting, on-prem policy enforcement (later phase). Success metrics: - 30% reduction in average days-to-contract for mid-market deals in pilot segments - <5% increase in legal rework for auto-approved exceptions - measured uplift in conversion using concession slider A/B (stat sig at p<0.05) - Telemetry: clause-approval time, prevalence of specific indemnity asks, average concession monetary impact Rollout plan: Alpha with Customer Success and two pilot AE teams (North America SMB + EU mid-market) -> Beta expands to all SMB -> Enterprise opt-in with dedicated Legal override flag. Compliance: KMS/HSM audit events must be emitted for any doc containing customer data; security team runway required before enterprise launch.
acceptance_criteria: Clause scoring model deployed as an internal service with versioning and feature flags
Sales UI shows concession slider and recommended range per clause with tooltips
Auto-routing rules in Legal intake based on composite score (auto-approve, fast-path review, full legal review)
Telemetry dashboard for A/B experiment: time-to-sign, list price delta, rework rate
Audit log for every auto-approved exception, visible in the Console and retained per compliance retention policy

risks: Auto-approval false positives could increase legal exposure and financial risk
Sales misuse of concession slider if defaults are too aggressive could reduce ASP and increase churn
SSQ-to-contract mapping ambiguity for legacy customers without complete questionnaire responses
Regulatory differences (EU DPAs) require per-region policy which increases rule complexity
